name: Igou Nobutake
source:
An accomplice who has some kind of connection to Tsunuga’s past.
He secretly supports them by selling them arms and munitions from outside the city. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1144#characters]MangaGamer[/url]]

He is the ex-head of the Security Bureau at the MPD. 
[spoiler]He resigned under the pretense for demanding permission to order the forced entry that led to the unprecedented casualities and Shougo's SAT team's destruction.[/spoiler]
